To get an accurate answer, please refer to the full Prescribing Information for this product — specifically Section 6 (Adverse Reactions), and also Section 5 (Warnings and Precautions), which covers issues such as paradoxical bronchospasm, cardiovascular effects, deterioration of asthma/need for more frequent use, hypersensitivity reactions, and hypokalemia.
